info.name: FAOSTAT Bulk Download Catalog Data API
Query data from a FAOSTAT domain

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language code (en=English, es=Spanish, fr=French, ar=Arabic, zh=Chinese, ru=Russian)

params.name: domain
params.description: FAOSTAT domain code (e.g. QCL for Crops and livestock products, TM for Trade, RL for Land Use)

params.name: area
params.description: Comma-separated area codes (country/region codes, e.g. 5 for China). Use dimension endpoint to discover valid codes.

params.name: item
params.description: Comma-separated item codes (commodity codes, e.g. 15 for Wheat). Use dimension endpoint to discover valid codes.

params.name: element
params.description: Comma-separated element codes (statistical measure codes, e.g. 5510 for Area harvested). Use dimension endpoint to discover valid codes.

params.name: year
params.description: Comma-separated year values (e.g. 2020,2021,2022). Supports range notation.

params.name: year_start
params.description: Start year for a date range filter (inclusive).

params.name: year_end
params.description: End year for a date range filter (inclusive).

params.name: area_cs
params.description: Area code system to use: FAO (default) or ISO2, ISO3, M49.

params.name: item_cs
params.description: Item code system to use: FAO (default) or CPC.

params.name: output_type
params.description: Response format: objects (default, JSON array of objects) or arrays (JSON array of arrays) or csv (CSV text)

params.name: null_values
params.description: Include null/missing values in the response (true or false).

params.name: show_codes
params.description: Include dimension codes alongside labels in response (true or false).

params.name: show_unit
params.description: Include unit of measurement in response (true or false).

params.name: show_flags
params.description: Include data quality flags in response (true or false).

items.docs: Retrieves statistical data records from a specific FAOSTAT domain. Multiple filter values can be comma-separated. Returns JSON or CSV depending on output_type. When no filters are provided, returns all data for the domain (may be large).
